//: Copilot CLI MCP config — copy to ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json (or add via `/mcp add`).
//1: Reuses the three Syxx MCP servers already built under ~/Documents/Cline/MCP — they are standard MCP servers, usable by Copilot CLI and Cline alike. Adjust the absolute paths if your home dir differs, then `npm run build` in each server folder if build/ is missing.
//2: Copilot custom agents can also scope these per-agent via the `mcp-servers:` frontmatter block; see .github/agents/*.agent.md and COPILOT-BUILD-PROMPTS.md.

syxx-dns.//: DNS query/analysis — tools: dns_query, dns_doh_query (multi-vantage evidence for Prophet/Mirror)

syxx-sqlite.//: SQLite browser for Syxx server DBs — tools: sqlite_query, syxx_db_stats, syxx_db_inspect_{audit,kv,leak_tokens,passive_dns}

syxx-http.//: HTTP API testing for the Python server — tools: http_request, syxx_server_health, syxx_api_{startup,diff,leak_verify,pubkey}
